# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Hired girl and handmaiden  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 c21 P75](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0075), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has hair plaited into two crinkly tails tied with four bright blue ribbons, two of which sprout like overgrown wings from her neck. Her eyes easily brim with tears, and her brown hands are small. On special occasions, she wears stiffly starched white dresses.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Charlotta is an obedient, loyal, and affectionate handmaiden who loves her employer dearly. Though literal-minded and prone to worrying that things will go wrong, she willingly participates in imaginative pretenses without expressing judgment. She feels a deep sense of duty and takes great pride in her work and appearance.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

- To serve and care for Miss Lavendar faithfully  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- To learn to move and act with elegance like Anne Shirley  <sub>[v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050), [v2 c30 P28](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0028)</sub>

## History

Charlotta came to live at Echo Lodge to assist Miss Lavendar Lewis with household duties for board and clothes. She frequently entertained herself and Miss Lavendar by blowing a horn or laughing to trigger fairy-like echoes across the river. When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry visited, Charlotta served meals and demonstrated the property's echoes. She worried constantly about Miss Lavendar's loneliness and well-being, confiding her fears to Anne. When Stephen Irving returned to court Miss Lavendar, Charlotta was delighted by his arrival and hoped they would marry so Miss Lavendar would not be left alone. She worked tirelessly alongside Anne and Diana to clean Echo Lodge and prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding, waking Anne early on the day of the ceremony due to her anxiety about the weather. Following the wedding, Charlotta scheduled her move to Boston alongside Paul Irving to reside with Mr. Stephen Irving and Miss Lavendar.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 c21 P69](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0069), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 c21 P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest and last of the Bowman sisters to work at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- She was nicknamed 'Charlotta the Fourth' by Miss Lavendar to avoid confusion with her sisters  <sub>[v2 c21 P75](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0075), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
